```plato

    // True when the parameter lines meet orthogonally at uv, within the given
    // non-negative tolerance on the shear coefficient F.
    IsOrthogonalAt(self: IDifferentiableSurface, uv: UvCoordinate, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.FirstFundamentalF(uv).Abs <= tolerance;
```
